rules: Every image file under public/imagery/ MUST have an entry here.
If license is 'pending' or 'unconfirmed', the page consumer must wrap the image with a HeritagePlaceholder note OR the file must not yet exist (manifest entry is the placeholder).
Manufacturer product images: dealer-portal / press-kit / authorized-resource only. Public website images are NOT licensed for third-party commercial use without a manufacturer agreement.
Heritage job photography: only used after explicit homeowner permission (Founder Input page §10).
Unsplash: free for commercial use under the Unsplash License. Attribution recommended, not required.
